lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate: Shyvana generates Scalemail stack from scoring takedown against certain enemies. Large monster and large minions grant 1 stack, while enemy champions and epic monsters grant 3.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Scalemail: For each stack, Shyvana gains 0.4 bonus armor and 0.4 bonus magic resistance.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Passive: Shyvana's basic attacks on-hit deal bonus magic damage equal to 1% . Against non-champions, this damage deals a minimum of 10 and is capped at 200. Additionally, her basic attacks on-hit reduce the remaining cooldown of Emberstrike by 1.25 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Shyvana empowers her next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain range|50 bonus range and trigger a blast in the target's direction that deals 10–30 (+ 110% AD) (+ 25% AP) modified physical damage to enemies hit in a cone. Emberstrike's damage to the primary target is affected by critical strike modifiers. After 1.5 seconds of using the empowered attack, or immediately after her next basic attack, Shyvana can recast Emberstrike within and the next 4 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: First Recast: Shyvana mimics the first cast's effects, instead creating the blast around the primary target.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Dragon's Descent|Dragon Form Bonus:}} After 1.5 seconds of using the recast's empowered attack, or immediately after her next basic attack, Shyvana can recast Emberstrike a second time within and the next 4 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Second Recast: Shyvana empowers her next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain range|50 bonus range and cause her to bite the target, dealing them 15–45 (+ 165% AD) (+ 37.5% AP) . This attack cannot critically strike.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Emberstrike's empowered attack deals 10 bonus damage to monsters.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: All Emberstrike casts basic attack reset Shyvana's basic attack timer.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: 10–6 seconds (starts post-effect).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cast Time: None, Effect Radius: .

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Shyvana grants herself a shield for 60–140 (+ 5% maximum health) for 2.5 seconds, increased by 30% for every nearby enemy champion. While the shield holds, she gains 25% bonus movement speed, increased to while facing sight enemy champions.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: After 1 second, Inferno Aegis can be recast while the shield holds and does so automatically after it expires or is broken.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Recast: Shyvana consumes the shield to unleash an explosion around her, dealing 80–160 (+ 40% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Dragon's Descent|Dragon Form Bonus:}} If the recast's explosion hits an enemy champion, Shyvana heal for 100+(250-100)*(x-1)/17 (1–20) (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 5% AP), increased by 0–100% (over 0–100)|health for a maximum heal of (100+(250-100)*(x-1)/17)*2 (1–20) (+ 20% bonus AD) (+ 10% AP).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: 14–12 seconds (starts on-cast).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cast Time: None, Effect Radius: .

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Shyvana launches a fireball in the target direction that explodes upon colliding with the first enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing 80–240 (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 70% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies and slowing them by 30–50% for 2 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Dragon's Descent|Dragon Form Bonus:}} Molten Burst's fireball damage is increased by 25%. The fireball is wider, can pass through enemies, and scorches the ground along its path for 2 seconds. Upon hitting an enemy champion or large monster, or reaching maximum range, the fireball triggers an explosion centered around the target or location that deals the same damage to nearby enemies and applies the same slow. The explosion also scorches the ground in the same radius for 2 seconds. Enemies within a scorched field are dealt 15–4 (+ 5/4% AP) magic damage every 0.25 seconds, for a total maximum damage of 30–50 (+ 10% AP). Enemies may be damaged by only one scorched field at a time. Subsequent explosions that hit the same target deal 50% damage.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: 12–10 seconds.

lines.note: Passive - Fury: Shyvana generates 0.5–1 (3 ranks)|Fury (+ 0.015 per 1 ultimate haste) Fury per second while in Human Form. Her basic attacks and abilities also generate 1.25 Dragon Fury for every enemy they hit, up to once per enemy per cast instance and increasedduring Dragon Form. Against non-champions hit by abilities, the generated amount is reduced toShyvana gains 100 Dragon Fury upon learning Dragon's Descent.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Active: Shyvana transforms into Dragon Form and dash with displacement immunity in the target direction, exhaling a wave of fire in a cone along the way that deals 150–350 (3 ranks) (+ 100% AP) magic damage to enemies struck and fear them for 1 second.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Dragon Form: Shyvana gains 150–350 (3 ranks) health|bonus health, 25–75 (3 ranks) range|bonus attack range, and 5–20 (3 ranks)% increased size. Her basic abilities are also empowered to apply an additional effect. She maintains Dragon Form at a recurring cost of Dragon Fury, returning to Human Form once all Dragon Fury has been depleted.
